zh: 从仓库安装时这个包自己构建一次：`prepare` 跑构建，装出来的包里带上 `lib/host/index.js`，不再因为缺宿主半边而启用失败；lint 在发布入口指向 `lib/` 时要求 `scripts.prepare` 存在。
en: The package now builds itself when installed from the repository: `prepare` runs the build, so the installed copy carries `lib/host/index.js` and no longer fails to activate without its host half; lint requires `scripts.prepare` whenever a published entry points into `lib/`.
